sentences.en: Among the manufacturers of so-called consumer electronics, there's ruthless, cut-throat competition.
sentences.zh: 在所谓的消费电子制造商之间，竞争极其残酷。

sentences.en: In the face of ruthless competition, our business failed to survive.
sentences.zh: 面对如此残酷的竞争，我们的业务未能生存下来。

sentences.en: I had no idea that you were so ruthless.
sentences.zh: 我没想到你会这么无情。

senses.zh: 无情的，冷酷的；（行为等）坚决的，果断的
